widgets.title: Applications with at least one security signal

latestCypherQueries.query:
MATCH (app:Application)
OPTIONAL MATCH (app)-[:HAS_REPO]->(:Repository)-[:CONTAINS]->(si:SastIssue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (app)-[:HAS_REPO]->(:Repository)-[:CONTAINS]->(:File)-[:IMPORTS]->(:Library)<-[:AFFECTS]-(lcve:CVE)
OPTIONAL MATCH (app)-[:RUNNING_ON]->(sw:Software)<-[:AFFECTS]-(rcve:CVE)
OPTIONAL MATCH (app)-[:RUNNING_ON]->(srv:Server)<-[:RUNNING_ON]-(sw2:Software)<-[:AFFECTS]-(rcve2:CVE)
WITH app,
     count(DISTINCT si) AS sastCount,
     count(DISTINCT lcve) AS libCveCount,
     count(DISTINCT rcve) + count(DISTINCT rcve2) AS runtimeCveCount
WHERE sastCount > 0 OR libCveCount > 0 OR runtimeCveCount > 0
RETURN count(app) AS value;

OPTIONAL MATCH (app)-[:HAS_REPO]->(:Repository)-[:CONTAINS]->(si:SastIssue)

latestCypherQueries.query:
MATCH (c:CVE)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:AFFECTS]->(:Library)<-[:IMPORTS]-(:File)<-[:CONTAINS]-(:Repository)<-[:HAS_REPO]-(a1:Application)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:AFFECTS]->(:Software)<-[:RUNNING_ON]-(a2:Application)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:AFFECTS]->(:Software)-[:RUNNING_ON]->(:Server)<-[:RUNNING_ON]-(a3:Application)
WITH c, collect(DISTINCT a1) + collect(DISTINCT a2) + collect(DISTINCT a3) AS rawApps
UNWIND rawApps AS app
WITH c, app
WHERE app IS NOT NULL
WITH c, collect(DISTINCT app) AS apps
RETURN c.cve_code AS category, size(apps) AS value
ORDER BY value DESC, category;

widgets.title: Converging exposure: business process + code issue + CVE + reachable server

latestCypherQueries.query:
MATCH (bp:BusinessProcess)-[:CALLS]->(:Activity)-[:USES]->(app:Application)
OPTIONAL MATCH (app)-[:HAS_REPO]->(:Repository)-[:CONTAINS]->(si:SastIssue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (app)-[:HAS_REPO]->(:Repository)-[:CONTAINS]->(:File)-[:IMPORTS]->(:Library)<-[:AFFECTS]-(libCve:CVE)
OPTIONAL MATCH (app)-[:RUNNING_ON]->(sw:Software)<-[:AFFECTS]-(runCve1:CVE)
OPTIONAL MATCH (app)-[:RUNNING_ON*1..3]->(srv:Server)<-[:RUNNING_ON]-(sw2:Software)<-[:AFFECTS]-(runCve2:CVE)
OPTIONAL MATCH (app)-[:RUNNING_ON*1..3]->(srv2:Server)
OPTIONAL MATCH (entry:Server)-[:CONNECTED_WITH*1..3]->(srv2)
WHERE entry.name STARTS WITH 'bank-prd-web' OR entry.name = 'bank-prd-bastion-01'
WITH bp, app,
     count(DISTINCT si) AS sastCount,
     count(DISTINCT libCve) AS libCveCount,
     count(DISTINCT runCve1) + count(DISTINCT runCve2) AS runtimeCveCount,
     collect(DISTINCT srv2.name) AS servers,
     collect(DISTINCT entry.name) AS entryPoints
WHERE sastCount > 0
  AND (libCveCount > 0 OR runtimeCveCount > 0)
  AND size([x IN entryPoints WHERE x IS NOT NULL]) > 0
RETURN bp.name AS businessProcess,
       bp.revenue AS revenue,
       app.name AS application,
       sastCount AS sastIssues,
       libCveCount AS libraryCVEs,
       runtimeCveCount AS runtimeCVEs,
       [x IN servers WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS servers,
       [x IN entryPoints WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS entryPoints,
       (sastCount + (2 * libCveCount) + (2 * runtimeCveCount)) AS riskScore
ORDER BY riskScore DESC, revenue DESC, businessProcess, application;
